description: This file defines a Java class AccrualBalances that models the accrual balances related to interest, fees, and penalties in a loan account within the Fineract project. It contains fields for interestPortion, feePortion, and penaltyPortion, all initialized to zero, and uses Lombok annotations for getters and setters.

classes.name: AccrualBalances
classes.description: A data class representing the accrual balances for interest, fees, and penalties in a loan account.

methods.name: getInterestPortion
methods.description: Returns the current interest portion stored in the object.

methods.name: getFeePortion
methods.description: Returns the current fee portion stored in the object.

methods.name: getPenaltyPortion
methods.description: Returns the current penalty portion stored in the object.
